question:
Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word.

Impossible
solution:
The correct answer is "**Applicable**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **The word 'impossible' means something that cannot be done or achieved.(**असंभव)

 
 
• ​Example: That was an impossible task to do.
 
 
 
• **The word 'applicable' means something that is relevant or suitable in a particular situation**.(उपयुक्त)
 
 
• Example: This part of the form is only applicable to married women.
 
 
 
 
 
• Therefore, the opposite of 'impossible' in this context is 'applicable'.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Shaky (Option 1) means unsteady or unstable.(अस्थिर)
 
• Unsure (Option 3) means uncertain or hesitant.(अनिश्चित)
 
• Unlikely (Option 4) means improbable or not expected.(संभावना नहीं)
